# Authoring pages with LOTC components

A page is written **once** in `<c-*>` tags and rendered to a design system (NLDD-first here). This guide is generated from the code — 178 components, 45 layout primitives.

## 1. Activate

```python
from lord_of_the_components import setup_components
# layout layer + a design system (NLDD is the default target)
setup_components(env, design_systems=["lotc-layout", "nldd"])
```
Rules: components resolve to the **first** active system that implements them; `lotc-layout` owns the structural primitives, `nldd` the visual components. Swap `nldd`→`rvo` to retarget the same markup.

## 2. Page skeleton

```html
<c-page title="…" lang="nl" design-systems="lotc-layout nldd">
  <c-app-shell width="16rem">
    <template slot="header">   …c-header, c-bar…        </template>
    <template slot="sidebar">  <c-sidenav>…</c-sidenav>  </template>
    …main content…
    <template slot="footer">   <c-footer>…</c-footer>    </template>
  </c-app-shell>
</c-page>
```
Named slots are filled with `<template slot="name">…</template>`; anything else is the default (main) content.

## 3. Layout primitives

Structural, theme-agnostic, intrinsically responsive (no media queries). Compose freely.

| Component | Purpose | Key attrs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<c-app-shell>` | Application shell layout (header / sidebar / main / footer) via named grid areas; regions come from <template slot="header\|sidebar\|footer">, main from the body | direction, width |
| `<c-layout>` | Page shell: optional header + footer, and a main area with an optional sidebar that wraps below on narrow screens (intrinsic, mobile-first) | side, sidebar-width, gap, max |
| `<c-grid>` | Auto-fill grid layout with equal-width columns | columns, gap, min, division |
| `<c-auto-grid>` | Responsive column grid: as many columns as fit at a minimum width, then wrap | min, gap |
| `<c-columns>` | Grid with an explicit column count and a mobile-first per-breakpoint fallback (cols = base; sm/md/lg override upward) | columns, sm, md, lg, gap |
| `<c-stack>` | Flex stack with an explicit direction (vertical \| horizontal), enforced uniformly across themes | direction, gap, wrap, align, justify |
| `<c-cluster>` | Wrapping group of inline items with a uniform gap (Every Layout: Cluster) | gap, justify, align |
| `<c-bar>` | A horizontal bar with start / center / end regions — the nav/toolbar pattern (e.g. links left, an action right). Fill regions via <template slot="start\|center\|end">; plain children go to start. | gap, align |
| `<c-sidebar>` | Content + a fixed-ish side column that wraps below when space runs out (Every Layout: Sidebar) | side, width, content-min, gap |
| `<c-switcher>` | Items in a row that switch to a vertical stack below a threshold width (Every Layout: Switcher) | threshold, gap |
| `<c-center>` | Max-width, horizontally centred container (Every Layout: Center) | max, gutters, text, intrinsic |
| `<c-cover>` | Min-height region that vertically centres its main content, with optional top/bottom items (Every Layout: Cover) | min, space |
| `<c-box>` | A padded container with an optional border — the simplest layout unit (Every Layout: Box) | pad, border, background |

**Alignment — "N left, M right"** is `c-bar` (grid start/center/end):

```html
<c-bar gap="sm">
  <template slot="start"><a>Overzicht</a><a>Apps</a><a>Code</a></template>
  <template slot="end"><c-button type="primary" label="Nieuw"/></template>
</c-bar>
```

## 4. Spacing config

All layout spacing comes from one overridable token scale. `gap="sm|md|lg|…"` resolves to a token; a raw value (`gap="1.25rem"`) or `0`/`none` also work. Retune everything by redefining these in your own `:root`:

| token | default |
| --- | --- |
| `--lotc-space-3xs` | `0.125rem` |
| `--lotc-space-2xs` | `0.25rem` |
| `--lotc-space-xs` | `0.5rem` |
| `--lotc-space-sm` | `0.75rem` |
| `--lotc-space-md` | `1rem` |
| `--lotc-space-lg` | `1.5rem` |
| `--lotc-space-xl` | `2rem` |
| `--lotc-space-2xl` | `3rem` |
| `--lotc-space-3xl` | `4rem` |

## 5. Extended components (theme-owned attributes)

A component can carry base attributes (always valid) + extension attributes owned by a design system (valid only while that system is active; else a clear error).

- `<c-box>` — theme-owned: `pad` (lotc-layout), `border` (lotc-layout), `background` (nldd)

## 6. Chart set (opt-in — Chart.js)

An opt-in capability set: activate it alongside a design system and it loads Chart.js + draws request/limit lines. Only then do these resolve.

```python
setup_components(env, design_systems=["lotc-layout", "nldd", "lotc-charts"])
```
- `<c-line-chart>` — Line chart (Chart.js) — time-series metrics (CPU, memory, network…)
  <br>attrs: `data`, `id`, `height`, `legend` (bool), `title`, `current`, `limit`, `request`
- `<c-gauge>` — Radial gauge (Chart.js doughnut) — a utilization percentage
  <br>attrs: `value`, `label`, `sublabel`, `id`, `color`
```html
<c-line-chart id="cpu" title="CPU (millicores)" limit="500" request="250"
              current="Current: 148m / 500m (30%)"
              :data="{'labels': [...], 'datasets': [{'label':'CPU','data':[...],'borderColor':'#39870c','fill':true}]}"/>
<c-gauge value="72" label="CPU" sublabel="2.9 / 4 cores"/>
```
Each chart needs a unique `id`. `limit`/`request` draw dashed threshold lines.

## 7. Form set (opt-in — labelled fields + ARIA)

An opt-in capability set of labelled form fields. Activate it **last**, after the visual theme. The same markup renders a theme-correct field (NLDD native `nldd-form-field`, RVO `rvo-form-field`) with the ARIA wiring guaranteed: label `for`/`id`, help + error via `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` on error.

```python
setup_components(env, design_systems=["lotc-layout", "nldd", "lotc-forms"])
```
- `<c-text-input-field>` — Labelled single-line text input with help/error and ARIA wiring
  <br>attrs: `id`, `name`, `label`, `type` (text\|email\|tel\|url\|number\|search), `value`, `placeholder`, `autocomplete`, `help`, +4
- `<c-textarea-field>` — Labelled multi-line text input with help/error and ARIA wiring
  <br>attrs: `id`, `name`, `label`, `value`, `placeholder`, `rows`, `help`, `error`, +3
- `<c-select-field>` — Labelled select; options are <c-option> children
  <br>attrs: `id`, `name`, `label`, `value`, `placeholder`, `help`, `error`, `required` (bool), +1
- `<c-radio-button-field>` — Labelled radio group; radios are <c-radio> children
  <br>attrs: `id`, `name`, `label`, `help`, `error`, `required` (bool)
- `<c-checkbox-field>` — Labelled checkbox group; checkboxes are <c-checkbox> children
  <br>attrs: `id`, `name`, `label`, `help`, `error`, `required` (bool)
- `<c-date-input-field>` — Labelled date input with help/error and ARIA wiring
  <br>attrs: `id`, `name`, `label`, `value`, `min`, `max`, `help`, `error`, +2
- `<c-file-input-field>` — Labelled file input. NLDD has no native file field, so under NLDD it renders the RVO field with a visible fallback badge.
  <br>attrs: `id`, `name`, `label`, `accept`, `multiple` (bool), `help`, `error`, `required` (bool), +1
- `<c-fieldset>` — Groups related fields under a legend; fields are children
  <br>attrs: `id`, `legend`, `label`
- `<c-action-group>` — A row of form actions (buttons); buttons are children
  <br>attrs: `align` (start\|end\|between)

Every field takes the same base — `id`, `name`, `label` (+ `help`, `error`, `required`, `disabled`). `file-input-field`: NLDD has no native file field, so it renders the RVO field with a visible fallback badge.

```html
<form method="post">
  <c-fieldset legend="Projectgegevens">
    <c-text-input-field id="naam" name="naam" label="Projectnaam" help="…" required/>
    <c-select-field id="afd" name="afd" label="Afdeling" placeholder="Kies…">
      <c-option value="bz" label="Burgerzaken"/></c-select-field>
    <c-radio-button-field id="zicht" label="Zichtbaarheid" error="Maak een keuze">
      <c-radio name="zicht" value="pub" label="Openbaar"/></c-radio-button-field>
  </c-fieldset>
  <c-action-group align="end"><c-button type="primary" label="Opslaan"/></c-action-group>
</form>
```

## 9. Full page example — BG "Software-catalogus"

A complete page, 100% `c-*`: app-shell → header (status-bar + menu) + sidenav + metric grid + filter-bar + catalog cards + footer. Copy and adapt — this is the BG look. Two more complete pages live in `tests/visual/fixtures/{zelf,bg-overzicht}.html` (built by `tests/visual/gen_{apps,zelf,bg_overzicht}.py`).

```html
      <c-catalog-card icon="rectangle-stack" title="Vergunningchecker" subtitle="Vergunningen & Regelingen" status="ok" status-type="success" maturity="zilver" open-label="Open" href="/apps/vergunningchecker"><c-tag type="default">service</c-tag><c-tag type="info">Kotlin</c-tag><c-tag type="info">Postgres</c-tag></c-catalog-card>
      <c-catalog-card icon="rectangle-stack" title="Inkomenstoets" subtitle="Inning & Invordering" status="ok" status-type="success" maturity="goud" open-label="Open" href="/apps/inkomenstoets"><c-tag type="default">service</c-tag><c-tag type="info">Java</c-tag><c-tag type="info">Oracle</c-tag></c-catalog-card>
      <c-catalog-card icon="rectangle-stack" title="Aangifte Omzetbelasting" subtitle="Aangifteplatform" status="warn" status-type="warning" maturity="zilver" open-label="Open" href="/apps/aangifte-omzetbelasting"><c-tag type="default">service</c-tag><c-tag type="info">Java</c-tag><c-tag type="info">Kafka</c-tag></c-catalog-card>
    </c-auto-grid>
  </c-stack>

  <template slot="footer">
    <c-site-footer text="Begane Grond — demo / mock-up" note-label="Presentatie" note="Shift + P · kies een rol" note-icon="eye">
      <c-link href="/standaarden">Toegankelijkheid</c-link>
    </c-site-footer>
  </template>
</c-app-shell>
</c-page>
```

## 10. Recipes

**Card grid** (as many columns as fit):
```html
<c-auto-grid min="280px" gap="md">
  <c-catalog-card icon="rectangle-stack" title="Paspoortaanvraag" subtitle="Burgerzaken"
                  status="ok" status-type="success" maturity="goud" open-label="Open" href="/apps/x">
    <c-tag type="default">service</c-tag><c-tag type="info">Rust</c-tag>
  </c-catalog-card>
</c-auto-grid>
```
**Metric row** (dashboard stats):
```html
<c-auto-grid min="220px" gap="md">
  <c-metric icon="rectangle-stack" value="123" label="Applicaties" sub="in de catalogus"/>
</c-auto-grid>
```
**Form:**
```html
<c-form>
  <c-form-field label="Naam"><c-text-field placeholder="Vul je naam in"/></c-form-field>
  <c-form-actions><c-button type="primary" label="Versturen"/></c-form-actions>
</c-form>
```

## 11. Rules

- **Slots**: named slots via `<template slot="name">…</template>`; default content is the rest.
- **Enums are validated**: an out-of-set value (e.g. `type="bogus"`) errors (debug mode) with the allowed set.
- **Theme-owned attrs** (§5) only work while their owner is active, else a clear error.
- **Unknown component / attribute** → a hard error with a suggestion.
- One source, many themes: the same markup renders under `nldd` or `rvo`; the visual system swaps, the structure stays.
